limits: A bank descriptor does not identify purchased items or original warranty. A successful scrape or exact quote is not a coverage decision. Benefits administrator retains final claim authority.
privacy: Public-source retrieval should use card/product identifiers, not bank credentials, full transactions, card numbers or personal receipts. Personal evidence and evaluations remain private.
qa: Hand-checked examples are regression/quality checks, not a prerequisite to supporting a card. Human escalation for ambiguous or conflicting clauses only.
sources: Issuer benefit guide for exact card variant and region, effective at purchase date; manufacturer warranty for exact item/model and region; merchant return policy when relevant. Bright Data is retrieval transport, not the authority.
status: agreed product direction; live research pipeline not yet implemented in Benny+
trigger: Each new or materially changed purchase, corrected card/item identity, evidence update, or relevant policy-version change queues an evaluation.
workflow: Resolve confirmed paying account and card product; identify item from evidence or ask user.

Reuse a valid applicable policy snapshot; refresh official sources when absent, stale, changed, or explicitly requested. Deduplicate requests across purchases without sharing private purchase details.

AI reads and structures source text with exact citations; deterministic checks validate quote presence, numeric/date consistency, applicability, completeness and conflicts. Quote matching alone does not prove interpretation.
Version policy snapshots with URL, retrieval time, content hash, effective dates and source excerpts; do not silently replace historical terms with current ones.
Deterministic engine evaluates supported eligibility conditions; missing facts or unresolved source conflicts produce needs-information, not guaranteed coverage.
Save private, derived/rebuildable evaluation records with transaction/evidence versions, policy snapshot references, engine version, findings and reasons. UI updates as research completes.
